text:
Cloud cost is running 26.7% above its baseline (high severity). The increase began at 2026-09-22 10:00 UTC and was detected at 2026-09-22 12:00 UTC.

The likely root cause is search-service (root-cause confidence 95%). Its own behaviour changed, and the extra load spread along search-service -> redis, search-service -> database, database -> analytics. The next candidate, analytics (38%), was ruled out: its load rose x3.50, but that load is pushed by its callers; its own behaviour did not change. Estimated impact traced to search-service: $2,735/month.

Supporting evidence:
- Queries/request to database rose x3.98 (1.20 -> 4.78)
- User requests rose x1.20 (42,640 -> 51,236 per minute)
- Deployed v2.0 1h before its own behaviour changed
- Accounts for 99% of the estimated cost increase through the services it calls
- Total calls to redis rose x1.20
- Total calls to database rose x4.78
- Its change tracks the total cost curve (correlation 0.99)
- 1 similar past incident on record

Recommended: Fix search-service query amplification to database. Estimated saving $2,243/month, latency -70.8%, error rate -0.14pp, risk low. Not recommended: Reduce database capacity 25%, because latency +192% > +10% limit; error rate +17.0pp > +0.5pp limit; DB CPU 119% > 85% headroom limit.
